facts.text: I asked about the significance of the Brown v. Board of Education Supreme Court ruling in the Civil Rights Movement.
I said I had no idea that the Brown v. Board of Education ruling had such a big impact on the Civil Rights Movement.
I said there has been a lot of progress since the Civil Rights Movement.
I said there is still a lot of work left to do to overcome racism.
I asked whether we will ever fully overcome racism.
I agreed that racism is still alive and well in our society.
I said I am hopeful that continued education and advocacy can make a real difference.
I said it can be frustrating at times but we have to keep pushing for change.
I said every small step counts.
I asked for ways to promote inclusivity in communities.
I agreed with steps to promote inclusivity.
I said promoting inclusivity starts with each of us as individuals.
I said promoting inclusivity can be as simple as recognizing and challenging our own biases.
